title: The golden workbook has different values from the input in cells the task never asks the agent to touch, and these differences are far outside the 1% tolerance. The official check compares nearly every sheet in full, so a solution that follows the instructions exactly can still fail unless recalculation happens to reproduce the golden state (for example a circular or iterative Other Income calculation).
evidence: 'Work Sheet'!AB6 (=IS_BS_CF!AD34) is 2.25 in the input but 20.3344 in the golden; AF6 is 9 vs 81.34; AL6 is 2 vs 39.73. These carry through to 'Work Sheet'!AB5:AP5, AB10:AP12 and IS_BS_CF AD4:AR4, AD7, AD10, AD16, AD20, AD22. The answer_position covers 'Work Sheet'!A1:AP228 and 'IS_BS_CF'!A1:AR181.
confirmation: The golden adds 218 formulas in IS_BS_CF rows 142-169 (debt and interest-income schedule) that the prompt never asks for, since it covers only Formats and Report Tables.
